phases.name: The Last Laugh
phases.say: Oh, you're no fun at all. Let's play something else.

say.open: A new audience! Sit, sit. You'll be part of the act.
say.death: Every act... ends with a bow.

bestiary.lore: The card at the start of every road, and the thing that waits there for whoever steps off the edge.
bestiary.weakness: Holy. It is frail: it lives on not being hit.
bestiary.pattern: Knives at the weakest every turn and a confusing pratfall every third. At half health it speeds up, hides every third turn and goes after the least sane.
